quiz.prompt: What 3DS feature let you collect other players’ Miis just by walking past them?
quiz.explanation: StreetPass exchanged compatible data with nearby Nintendo 3DS systems.

quiz.prompt: Which of these pairs of countries share a land border?
quiz.explanation: French Guiana is a French overseas territory in South America.

quiz.prompt: In Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door, what are you collecting to open the door?
quiz.explanation: Star Spirits are from the original Paper Mario.

quiz.prompt: Which mob drops a wet sponge when defeated?
quiz.explanation: You can also find sponge rooms in some ocean monuments.

quiz.prompt: During a total lunar eclipse, why can the Moon look red?
options: The shadow hides only the blue parts of the Moon
Mars reflects light onto the Moon
The Moon heats up in Earth’s shadow
quiz.explanation: Some sunlight bends through Earth’s atmosphere. More of the red light reaches the Moon.

quiz.prompt: In The Wind Waker, what is the name of Link’s talking boat?
quiz.explanation: Link first encounters the boat after the Forsaken Fortress.

quiz.prompt: Which of these years was a leap year under the Gregorian calendar?
quiz.explanation: Century years are leap years when divisible by 400.

quiz.prompt: Which song sends Link back to the first morning in Majora’s Mask?
quiz.explanation: The Inverted Song of Time slows the clock instead.

quiz.prompt: Which block is used to charge a respawn anchor?
quiz.explanation: Crying obsidian is needed to craft the anchor. Glowstone adds charges.

quiz.prompt: In Tetris, which two pieces are mirror-image zigzags?
quiz.explanation: S and Z have opposing zigzag shapes. L and J are also mirror images, with one right angle each.

quiz.prompt: Which of these fruits is a botanical berry?
quiz.explanation: Strawberries and raspberries are aggregate fruits. A cherry is a drupe.

quiz.prompt: Which Divine Beast is shaped like a camel in Breath of the Wild?
quiz.explanation: Vah Naboris is found in the Gerudo Desert.

quiz.prompt: Which spiky Elder Dragon is the flagship monster of the base game?
quiz.explanation: Its signature spikes regrow during the fight.

quiz.prompt: What item do you give an adult piglin to barter with it?
quiz.explanation: A piglin inspects an ingot and then throws an item back.

quiz.prompt: When Pac-Man eats a Power Pellet, what happens to the ghosts?
options: They return to the maze edge
quiz.explanation: The frightened ghosts normally turn blue for a limited time.

quiz.prompt: Which pair of drinks is made from leaves of the same plant species?
quiz.explanation: Black and green tea both come from Camellia sinensis. The leaves are processed differently.

quiz.prompt: In the original Pikmin, which type can safely attack a fiery enemy?
quiz.explanation: Blue Pikmin can live in water. Red Pikmin can cross fire.

quiz.prompt: Which hero could throw Armor Packs to allies in Overwatch’s original 2016 version?
quiz.explanation: Brigitte was added later. The launch Armor Pack ability belonged to Torbjörn.

quiz.prompt: A sealed bag of crisps puffs up during a flight. What best explains it?
options: The air inside the bag leaks out
The air inside the bag gets colder
The bag absorbs moisture from the cabin
The air pressure outside the bag drops
quiz.explanation: The cabin is pressurized, but its pressure in flight is generally lower than at ground level.

quiz.prompt: In Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Ness and Lucas come from which series?
quiz.explanation: Ness is from EarthBound and Lucas is from Mother 3.

quiz.prompt: Which redstone component can read how full a container is?
quiz.explanation: A comparator’s output depends on the fullness of the container behind it.

quiz.prompt: Which city is the Overwatch map King’s Row based on?
quiz.explanation: The streets and architecture are modelled on a futuristic London.

quiz.prompt: Why does salting the ice around an ice cream maker help freeze the mixture?
options: Salt lowers the freezing point of water
Salt conducts heat out of the ice cream
Salt makes ice melt at a higher temperature
quiz.explanation: A mixture of ice and salt water can get colder than the freezing point of pure water.

quiz.prompt: What could you do using the microphone in the original Nintendogs?
options: Play music to set the walking pace
Record audio for other players to hear
Call the shopkeeper to order supplies
quiz.explanation: The microphone also let you teach voice commands.

quiz.prompt: Which enchantment lets you collect ordinary glass blocks intact with the appropriate tool?
quiz.explanation: Glass normally breaks without dropping the block.

quiz.prompt: Which pastry gets its layers from repeatedly folding butter into dough?
quiz.explanation: Steam separates sheets of laminated dough during baking.

quiz.prompt: How do WarioWare’s signature microgames differ from most minigames?
options: They give you only seconds to react
quiz.explanation: The game throws short tasks at you in rapid succession.

quiz.prompt: What typically spills out when a character breaks apart in a LEGO Star Wars level?
quiz.explanation: Players collect studs as currency throughout the levels.

quiz.prompt: Which setting mainly controls how long light reaches a camera’s sensor?
quiz.explanation: A longer exposure can blur motion.

quiz.prompt: What can you use with a trap to capture a weakened Rathian?
quiz.explanation: A weakened, trappable monster can be captured after it receives enough tranquilizer.

quiz.prompt: What happens if you use a compass on a lodestone?
options: It shows your own respawn point
quiz.explanation: A normal compass points toward world spawn in the Overworld.

quiz.prompt: On which Among Us map do you cross a snow-covered surface between buildings?
quiz.explanation: Polus is an outpost with substantial outdoor areas.

quiz.prompt: In which country do people normally drive on the left?
quiz.explanation: The other three use right-hand traffic.

quiz.prompt: Which two Kongs are playable in the original SNES Donkey Kong Country?
quiz.explanation: The original follows Donkey and Diddy. Dixie arrives in the sequel.

quiz.prompt: Which moon phase gives slimes the best chance to spawn at night in a swamp?
quiz.explanation: This is the swamp rule. Slime chunks use different conditions.

quiz.prompt: Which original Fortnite Battle Royale location was known for its cluster of tall buildings?
quiz.explanation: Tilted Towers put a dense city fight on the original island.

quiz.prompt: Which of these animated films reached cinemas first?
quiz.explanation: Shrek came out in 2001. The others followed in 2003, 2004, and 2007.

quiz.prompt: In Animal Crossing: New Horizons, which museum curator is afraid of bugs?
quiz.explanation: Blathers still accepts bugs for the museum.

quiz.prompt: Which cube does GLaDOS make you incinerate in the original Portal?
quiz.explanation: The Companion Cube is marked with hearts.

quiz.prompt: Which Pokémon series begins by turning the player into a Pokémon?
quiz.explanation: You explore dungeons with a partner Pokémon.

quiz.prompt: What resource repairs a held or equipped item with Mending?
quiz.explanation: Experience can restore durability instead of going into the XP bar.

quiz.prompt: Which number is written as XLIX in Roman numerals?
quiz.explanation: XL is 40 and IX is 9.

quiz.prompt: Which Pokémon is the Fire-type starter in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl?
quiz.explanation: The other Sinnoh starters are Turtwig and Piplup.

quiz.prompt: In Dark Souls, what happens to carried souls if you die again before reaching your bloodstain?
options: They return to the last bonfire
They are restored when you level up
quiz.explanation: You get one chance to retrieve the previous bloodstain.

quiz.prompt: What inspired the name of Bluetooth wireless technology?
options: A blue marker used in circuit diagrams
A term for pairing two radio channels
quiz.explanation: The technology was named for Harald Bluetooth, a Danish king.

quiz.prompt: Which planet is the main setting of the original Metroid Prime?
quiz.explanation: ZDR is the main setting of Metroid Dread.

quiz.prompt: Which World weapon uses a Kinsect to gather extracts from monsters?
quiz.explanation: Kinsect extracts provide buffs to the hunter.

quiz.prompt: Which bucketed fish can be used to breed axolotls?
quiz.explanation: Use a bucket containing a live tropical fish.

quiz.prompt: Which of these can travel through the vacuum between Earth and the Moon?
quiz.explanation: Radio waves are electromagnetic. Sound needs a medium such as air.

quiz.prompt: What is the DnD 5e Class with the highest single-target damage potential in a single round on level 1?
quiz.explanation: Wild Magic Sorcerers can use a combination of Chromatic Orb and Fireball through the Wild Magic Surge table to deal a maximum of 240 damage in a single round at level 1.

quiz.prompt: On Summoner’s Rift in League of Legends, which objective must you destroy to win a normal match?
quiz.explanation: Taking an inhibitor strengthens your lane but does not end the match.

quiz.prompt: Which Pokémon evolves into Vaporeon when given a Water Stone?
quiz.explanation: Vaporeon is the Water-type evolution of Eevee.

quiz.prompt: Which action can demolish an opponent’s car in Rocket League?
options: Hit their car with the ball
Land on their roof at idle speed
quiz.explanation: A qualifying supersonic collision removes the opponent’s car until it respawns.

quiz.prompt: How many hearts does an octopus have?
quiz.explanation: Two pump blood to the gills. The third sends it to the rest of the body.

quiz.prompt: In Splatoon’s Turf War, what determines the winner?
quiz.explanation: Your team wins by inking more of the ground.

quiz.prompt: What is the English name of the red ghost in the original Pac-Man?
quiz.explanation: Pinky is pink, Inky is cyan, and Clyde is orange.

quiz.prompt: What color is the special jersey worn by the overall leader of the Tour de France?
quiz.explanation: The jersey is called the maillot jaune.

quiz.prompt: Which storage block keeps its contents when you break and pick it up?
quiz.explanation: Shulker shells are used to craft shulker boxes.

quiz.prompt: What is the name of the Rottweiler you can walk as Franklin in GTA V?
quiz.explanation: Chop originally belongs to Lamar.

quiz.prompt: Which drink is traditionally used to soak the ladyfingers in tiramisu?
quiz.explanation: Coffee-soaked biscuits are layered with a mascarpone mixture.

quiz.prompt: In Kirby’s Dream Land, who steals the people’s food at the start of the game?
quiz.explanation: Kirby sets out for Mount Dedede to recover the stolen food.

quiz.prompt: Which Overwatch hero uses Recall to return to a recent position?
quiz.explanation: Recall also restores Tracer’s health to its earlier value.

quiz.prompt: Which of these mammals can fly under its own power?
quiz.explanation: The other three glide. Bats use powered flight.

quiz.prompt: Which cap lets Mario pass through some walls in Super Mario 64?
quiz.explanation: The Vanish Cap lets Mario slip through barriers such as metal grates.

quiz.prompt: Who speaks to Chell during most of the tests in the original Portal?
quiz.explanation: Wheatley is introduced in Portal 2.

quiz.prompt: Which civilization built Machu Picchu?
quiz.explanation: The site lies high in the Peruvian Andes.

quiz.prompt: What is the name of Mario’s companion in Super Mario Odyssey?
quiz.explanation: Cappy helps Mario take control of enemies and objects.

quiz.prompt: Which material do you combine with diamond gear to upgrade it at a smithing table?
quiz.explanation: Modern versions also require the Netherite Upgrade template.

quiz.prompt: Who is the main playable character in Half-Life 2?
quiz.explanation: Gordon is the silent scientist from the original Half-Life.

quiz.prompt: Which element has the chemical symbol Na?
quiz.explanation: Na comes from natrium, the Latin name for sodium.

quiz.prompt: What three words make up the Unrelenting Force shout in Skyrim?
quiz.explanation: Fus, Ro, and Dah mean Force, Balance, and Push.

quiz.prompt: In tennis, what score is called after both players win three points in the same game?
quiz.explanation: Three points each is 40–40, also known as deuce.

quiz.prompt: What is the name of Captain Falcon’s machine in F-Zero?
quiz.explanation: The other three machines are driven by Samurai Goroh, Pico, and Dr. Stewart.

quiz.prompt: What town is home to Pierre’s shop and the Stardrop Saloon in Stardew Valley?
quiz.explanation: Pelican Town includes Pierre’s shop, the saloon, and the community center.

quiz.prompt: Which Beatles album cover shows the band on a zebra crossing?
quiz.explanation: The crossing is near the recording studios in London.

quiz.prompt: In Super Mario Sunshine, what device helps Mario clean up Isle Delfino?
quiz.explanation: F.L.U.D.D. is Mario’s water-spraying backpack.

quiz.prompt: In Super Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, how many players can play on one console?
quiz.explanation: The Switch 2 added support for up to 8 players on one console.

quiz.prompt: Which block can summon a Warden in the Deep Dark when activated repeatedly?
quiz.explanation: A naturally generated shrieker can call a Warden after enough warnings.

higherLower.secondItem: Collect the Triforce shards in The Wind Waker (original GameCube)
higherLower.explanation: The Wind Waker HD makes several shards easier to obtain but still uses eight pieces.

higherLower.prompt: Does Neptune have a greater or smaller diameter than Earth?
higherLower.explanation: The four giant planets are wider than Earth.

higherLower.prompt: Did the second Overworld have a greater or smaller buildable height range?
higherLower.explanation: Caves & Cliffs Part II added 64 blocks above and 64 below the old range.

higherLower.prompt: Is the second element’s atomic number higher or lower?
higherLower.explanation: Follow the periodic table from iron through cobalt and nickel to copper.

higherLower.prompt: Is the second liquid’s normal boiling point higher or lower?

higherLower.explanation: With comparable pressure, ethanol boils at a lower temperature.

higherLower.prompt: Does the second Mario Party collection have more or fewer minigames?

higherLower.explanation: The 2018 game has 80, while Superstars revisits 100 from earlier entries.

higherLower.prompt: Does the second game have a higher or lower maximum wanted level?

higherLower.prompt: Is the second mountain higher or lower?
higherLower.explanation: Mont Blanc's snow-covered summit changes height. This is the rounded 2023 survey value.

higherLower.prompt: Does the second Wii game include more or fewer sports?
higherLower.explanation: Resort adds activities such as archery, canoeing, and swordplay.

higherLower.prompt: Does Jupiter take more or fewer Earth days to orbit the Sun?
Is the second landmark taller or shorter?

higherLower.knownItem: Majora’s Mask before the moon falls
higherLower.secondItem: Pikmin before Olimar’s oxygen runs out
higherLower.explanation: Majora’s Mask lets Link reset its three-day cycle.

higherLower.prompt: Did the second Monster Hunter game release on Steam earlier or later?
higherLower.explanation: This comparison uses Steam dates, including Rise’s PC launch in 2022.

higherLower.prompt: Which takes more wear? Is the second pickaxe’s base durability higher or lower?
higherLower.explanation: These are base values before any enchantments.

higherLower.prompt: Did the second indie game first release on PC earlier or later?

numberGuess.prompt: In what year did euro banknotes and coins enter circulation?
numberGuess.explanation: The euro had already been introduced for accounting and electronic payments in 1999.

numberGuess.prompt: How many playable fighters are in the original Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 64, including unlockables?
numberGuess.explanation: Eight fighters are available at the start, and four more can be unlocked.

numberGuess.prompt: What score is considered a perfect game on the original arcade version of Pac-Man?
numberGuess.explanation: A perfect game requires every available point, including those on the split-screen stage.

numberGuess.prompt: How wide is the shorter edge of an A4 sheet of paper?
numberGuess.explanation: A4 measures 210 by 297 millimetres.

numberGuess.prompt: How many shrines can be completed in the base game of Breath of the Wild?
numberGuess.explanation: This excludes the Expansion Pass.

numberGuess.prompt: How many crying obsidian blocks are used to craft one respawn anchor?
numberGuess.explanation: The recipe also requires three glowstone blocks.

numberGuess.prompt: How many columns wide is the usual modern Tetris playfield?
numberGuess.explanation: One full horizontal row needs ten occupied cells.

numberGuess.prompt: How many seconds are in a 24-hour day?
numberGuess.explanation: Multiply 24 by 60 by 60.

numberGuess.prompt: How many named captains can you switch between in the main story of Pikmin 3?
numberGuess.explanation: Alph, Brittany, and Charlie are the three explorers.

numberGuess.prompt: How many nautilus shells are needed to craft a conduit around one Heart of the Sea?
numberGuess.explanation: The Heart of the Sea goes in the central slot.

numberGuess.prompt: In what year did Grand Theft Auto V first release on Windows PC?
numberGuess.explanation: The original PS3 and Xbox 360 launch was in 2013.

numberGuess.prompt: How many minutes does it take to watch a 2-hour, 20-minute movie at 1.25× speed?
numberGuess.explanation: Divide 140 minutes by 1.25.

numberGuess.prompt: How many players are on the field at once in Splatoon 3’s standard Tricolor Turf War?
numberGuess.explanation: Two two-player attacking teams face one four-player defending team.

numberGuess.prompt: How many different weapon types can a hunter choose from in Monster Hunter: World?
numberGuess.explanation: World has 11 melee and three ranged types.

numberGuess.prompt: How many iron ingots does it take to craft an anvil from scratch, including the ingots used for the iron blocks?
numberGuess.explanation: Three iron blocks cost 27 ingots, and the recipe uses four more ingots.

numberGuess.prompt: At its 2019 launch, how many squads could fill an Apex Legends match if every squad had three players?
numberGuess.explanation: The launch format was 60 players in 20 squads of three.

numberGuess.prompt: How many metres is one lap of a standard outdoor athletics track in lane one?
numberGuess.explanation: Standard outdoor tracks are 400 metres around in lane one.

numberGuess.prompt: How many race courses are in Mario Kart: Double Dash!! on GameCube, excluding battle arenas?
numberGuess.explanation: The four standard cups have four courses each. All-Cup Tour reuses those courses.

numberGuess.prompt: What is the highest level requirement an enchanting table can show with enough bookshelves?
numberGuess.explanation: Fifteen correctly placed bookshelves unlock the maximum offer.

numberGuess.prompt: How many Sims can be in one household in the base game of The Sims 4, without mods?
numberGuess.explanation: Eight is the default household member limit.

numberGuess.prompt: How long is a full marathon in kilometres?
numberGuess.explanation: The official distance is 42 km and 195 metres.

numberGuess.prompt: How many Gym Badges can you collect in the original Pokémon Gold or Silver, including both regions?
numberGuess.explanation: There are eight in Johto and eight in Kanto.

numberGuess.prompt: How many End Crystals are needed to respawn the Ender Dragon at the exit portal?
numberGuess.explanation: One crystal goes on each side of the exit portal.

numberGuess.prompt: How many playable heroes were in the original Overwatch at launch in 2016?
numberGuess.explanation: That is the launch roster, before post-launch heroes such as Ana.

numberGuess.prompt: How many hours are in one full non-leap year?
numberGuess.explanation: A non-leap year has 365 days of 24 hours each.

numberGuess.prompt: What is the maximum number of animal villagers on your island in Animal Crossing: New Horizons?
numberGuess.explanation: Human profiles and service characters such as Isabelle do not count.

numberGuess.prompt: In the base game, at what Hunter Rank does Thunderous Rumble in the Highlands unlock?
numberGuess.explanation: The assignment is to hunt a tempered Kirin.

numberGuess.prompt: How many blocks can an uninterrupted line of redstone dust carry a full-strength signal before it needs a boost?
numberGuess.explanation: The first piece is strength 15 and the fifteenth is strength 1.

numberGuess.prompt: How many minutes are on the clock at the start of a standard Rocket League match, before overtime?
numberGuess.explanation: A tie at the end of regulation goes to sudden-death overtime.
